The '''Bantha III''' was a model of open-topped, lightweight [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] cargo [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] produced by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]]. The skiffs were sufficiently large in size to carry a young [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and bore smooth lines, making them similar in appearance to other Ubrikkian pleasure-craft models.<ref name="Scourge" />
 
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto|Popara]], the leader of the Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|clan]] [[Anjiliac]], had a partially-assembled Bantha III skiff put into the cargo hold of the [[Suwantek Systems|Suwantek]] [[TL-1200 transport]] ''[[New Ambition]]''. The Suwantek [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], docked at [[landing pad X-13]] in the [[Makem Te spaceport|spaceport]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], was given by Popara to the [[Jedi archivist/Legends|Jedi archivist]] [[Mander Zuma]] and the [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Reen Irana]] and [[Eddey Be'ray]] for an assignment to rescue Popara's son Mika on the [[Quarantine of Endregaad|quarantined]] planet [[Endregaad]]. Upon arrival in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tel Bollin]], Endregaad's main settlement, Irana and Be'ray assembled the Bantha III skiff, which was then employed by the trio in their search for Mika.<ref name="Scourge" />
